notes: «- قال أحمد -» is a gloss and «المعنى» is a gloss on the narration by sense (rule 1): both left out.
«زاد عبد العزيز فما أسلم» is an addition by a transmitter already in the chain: a wording variant, left out.
Umm Sa'd is the last link: she speaks the saying («فقالت لا تقرأ»), and Dawud reads to her (rule 6).
